front: Crank your gizmos into overdrive with a Crafting check (standard DC for your level) to add damage to your Strikes for 1 minute.
back:
Crafting check, standard DC for your level.
Crit Success: Strikes deal extra damage = Int modifier for 1 min; afterward gizmos unusable and no Overdrive for 1 min.
Success: as crit success, but extra damage = half Int modifier.
Failure: Strikes deal 1 extra fire damage for 1 min.
Crit Failure: take fire damage = half level (round up); no Overdrive for 1d4 rounds.
Special: can reuse while active, but can't extend duration; a crit success upgrades it, a crit failure ends it.
